description: Adds resonance and a steeper slope to each of Vox Inhumana's five formant filters; it goes immediately to the right of Vox Inhumana

params.text: Adds resonance to that formant, on top of the resonance the chosen vowel and voice already give it, out to a Q of 20
Sets how far that formant's resonance input moves it, and in which direction
Switches that formant between a 6dB per octave slope and a 12dB per octave one

inputs.text: Voltage that moves that formant's resonance, by the amount its attenuverter sets
